# SHiSHKA Healthy Kitchen

> Healthy Middle Eastern & Russian kitchen in Rawai, Phuket, Thailand. Fresh, unprocessed, scientifically balanced real food made daily — no seed oils, no industrial gluten, no fried or fake food, no preservatives. Signature gluten-free manakish ("mini pizza") on house potato-based dough, mezze dips, salads, cold-pressed drinks, and craft bean-to-bar chocolate.

## About

SHiSHKA Healthy Kitchen ("from the SOIL to the SOUL") is a healthy kitchen and café in Rawai, on the south of Phuket island, Thailand. The menu blends Middle Eastern and Russian home cooking with a clean-eating philosophy: powerful nutrition, nothing artificial.

- **Location:** Rawai, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83130, Thailand
- **Map:** https://maps.app.goo.gl/ierQnY9AydVTVUtx8 (Plus Code Q8P8+XV9, Rawai)
- **Hours:** Open daily, 09:30–18:30
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +66 95 696 9059
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/shishka_healthy_kitchen
- **Website:** https://shishka.health/
- **Price range:** 35–349 THB per item (฿฿)

## The rule (what we never use)

Seed oils · industrial gluten · fake food · fried food · preservatives. We eliminate the noise that harms the body and replace it with real, nutrient-dense food.

## Cuisine & dietary options

- **Cuisines:** Middle Eastern, Russian, Mediterranean, healthy / clean eating
- **Dietary tags used across the menu:** gluten-free, vegan, vegetarian, halal, dairy-free, keto / low-carb, paleo
- Every dish lists calories and macros (protein / carbs / fat) and its allergens.

## Menu highlights

- **Manakish (gluten-free "mini pizza", ฿59–79):** a Middle-Eastern flatbread reimagined gluten-free on house potato-based dough — Za'atar Potato, 6 Cheese, Olive & Cheese, Lamb, Beef, Falafel, Sujuk, and the signature Truffle & Lamb.
- **Mezze dips (฿111–199):** Hummus, Beetroot Hummus, Mutabal (smoked eggplant dip), Muhammara (smoky pepper & walnut).
- **Salads (฿149–349):** Tabbouleh, Fattoush, Chicken & Shrimp Caesar (avocado dressing, seed crackers), Smoked Salmon Salad, Beetroot Walnut.
- **Bean-to-bar chocolate (฿197 / 100g):** 70% Dark, 70% Dark with Roasted Almond, High-Cocoa Milk.
- **Drinks:** smoothies, cold-pressed juices, lemonades, specialty coffee, matcha, and wellness shots.

## How to order

Visit the kitchen in Rawai, Phuket (open daily 09:30–18:30), or message **+66 95 696 9059** on WhatsApp. Full live menu with prices, photos, and nutrition at https://shishka.health/.
